title: KitchenOwl
name: kitchenowl
description: Grocery list and recipe manager for households, with shopping lists that sync live between everyone, recipes you can add to the list in one go, a meal planner and shared expenses. Source: https://github.com/TomBursch/kitchenowl

env.name: KITCHENOWL_SECRET
env.label: Secret key (required)
env.description: Signs everyone's logins. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it the same when you redeploy, or everyone gets logged out.

env.name: KITCHENOWL_PORT
env.label: Host port for the web UI

note: Set the secret key before you deploy (openssl rand -hex 32 makes a good one), since the stack won't start without it. Then open http://<your-host>:8070 (or whichever port you picked) and the first page creates the admin account. There's no setup code, so do it straight after deploying. Sign-ups are off, so the admin adds everyone else under Settings --> Users, then adds them to a household's members. The SQLite database and uploaded photos live in the kitchenowl-data volume. Docs: docs.kitchenowl.org
